description: This module can manage resources in a Pacemaker cluster using the pacemaker CLI.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: Specify the resource name to create or clone to. This is required if state=present, state=absent, state=enabled, or state=disabled.

parameters.name: resource_clone_ids
parameters.description: List of clone resource IDs to clone from.

parameters.name: resource_clone_meta
parameters.description: List of metadata to associate with clone resource.

parameters.name: resource_meta
parameters.description: List of meta to associate with resource.

parameters.name: resource_operation
parameters.description: List of operations to associate with resource. Default: []

parameters.name: resource_option
parameters.description: Specify the resource option to create. Default: []

parameters.name: state
parameters.description: Indicate desired state for cluster resource. The states cleanup and cloned have been added in community.general 11.3.0. If state=cloned or state=present, you can set resource_clone_ids and resource_clone_meta to determine exactly what and how to clone. Choices: "present" ← (default) "absent" "cloned" "enabled" "disabled" "cleanup"

parameters.name: wait
parameters.description: Timeout period for polling the resource creation. Default: 300

examples:
---
- name: Create pacemaker resource
  hosts: localhost
  gather_facts: false
  tasks:
    - name: Create virtual-ip resource
      community.general.pacemaker_resource:
        state: present
        name: virtual-ip
        resource_type:
          resource_name: IPaddr2
        resource_option:
          - "ip=[192.168.2.1]"
        resource_argument:
          argument_action: group
          argument_option:
            - master
        resource_operation:
          - operation_action: monitor
            operation_option:
              - interval=20

return_values.name: cluster_resources
return_values.description: The cluster resource output message. Returned: always Sample: "Assumed agent name ocf:heartbeat:IPaddr2 (deduced from IPaddr2)"
